{user_content}
""" def render_html_page(visitor_message: str, html_template: str = HTML_TEMPLATE) -> str: """ Return an HTML page with the user's message safely embedded. Parameters ---------- visitor_message : str Content supplied by the user. html_template : str, optional The HTML template containing a `{user_content}` placeholder. Returns ------- str The final HTML string with the escaped user content. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_message, quote=True) return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
